notes.title: "DIGITAL EXORCIST" to Exhibit at Tokyo Game Show 2025
notes.notes: [h1]"DIGITAL EXORCIST" to Exhibit at Tokyo Game Show 2025[/h1][h2]Play the Latest Demo at Makuhari Messe![/h2][p][/p][p]"DIGITAL EXORCIST" is officially announced to participate in Tokyo Game Show 2025 (TGS2025), held at Makuhari Messe from September 25 (Thursday) to September 28 (Sunday), 2025. Attendees will have the opportunity to experience the latest playable demo of the game at the dedicated booth, and we will also be running a campaign where those who add the game to their Wishlist will receive an original acrylic keychain. [/p][p]*Please note that numbers are limited.[/p][p][/p][h3]Exhibition Details[/h3][quote][p][b]Dates:[/b] September 25 (Thursday) - September 28 (Sunday), 2025[/p][p][b]Times:[/b][/p][p]Business Days (September 25 - 26): 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM[/p][p]Public Day (September 27): 9:30 AM - 5:00 PM[/p][p]Public Day (September 28): 9:30 AM - 4:30 PM[/p][p][b]Venue:[/b] Makuhari Messe[/p][p][b]Booth Name:[/b] HYPER REAL[/p][p][b]Location:[/b] Hall 11 | Booth Number E19[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]We look forward to welcoming you to our booth![/p]

notes.title: Publisher Announcement + Demo Debut at Bitsummit the 13th!
notes.notes: [p]We're excited to announce that HYPER REAL is now the official publisher of [b]DIGITAL EXORCIST[/b]. [b]DIGITAL EXORCIST[/b] is a PC-98-style cyber-occult adventure game by COOL BEANS PRODUCTIONS.[/p][p]The full game is planned for release in 2026 on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h3]Try Out the Prologue![/h3][p]To commemorate this announcement, Japanese language support has been added to the free prologue title, [b]DIGITAL EXORCIST case_(0);[/b].[/p][p]Localization of the prologue was handled by renowned translator, Yosei Mutou, who is known for work on titles such as [b]VA-11 Hall-A[/b] and [b]Gone Home[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][u]Try out [b]DIGITAL EXORCIST case_(0);[/b] here:[/u][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2299040/DIGITAL_EXORCIST_case_0/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]BitSummit the 13th - Play the Demo in Kyoto![/h3][p]The demo for [b]DIGITAL EXORCIST[/b] will make its world premiere at BitSummit the 13th, held in Kyoto, Japan from July 18 to 20, 2025. The demo will be playable in both English and Japanese. Other titles that will be featured at the booth include [b]SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim[/b], [b]SKY THE SCRAPER[/b], and [b]Telebbit[/b]. Come by the booth, try out our games, and grab some exclusive merch while supplies last! [/p][p][/p][h3]Exhibition Overview[/h3][quote][p][b]Dates:[/b] 2025/7/18 (FRI) - 2025/7/20 (SUN) 10:00 - 17:00 [/p][p][b]Venue:[/b] Kyoto Kangyo-Kan "Miyako Messe", 1F, Exhibition Hall 2[/p][p][b]Booth Name:[/b] HYPER REAL [/p][p][b]Booth Location:[/b] IP2-16[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the new language support, and we look forward to seeing you at BitSummit![/p][p]COOL BEANS PRODUCTIONS & HYPER REAL[/p]
